subject: English
title: Tamil Nadu State Board English, Class IV

source.read: SCERT Tamil Nadu, TNCF 2017 syllabus, English language, Standards 1 to 10 (published in the Tamil Nadu Government Gazette), read through a copy hosted by an exam-coaching site
source.note: UNOFFICIAL COPY OF AN OFFICIAL SOURCE. The state's own syllabus (TNCF 2017, marked draft), read through a text summary of a third-party copy of the gazette pages; the Standard 9 page was only partly readable. The Samacheer Kalvi textbooks follow it term by term.
